Chapter 01

Brand
Foundations

Who Urban Money Wealth is, how it relates to the Urban Money masterbrand, and how it sounds when it speaks about money.

Who we are

About Urban Money Wealth

Urban Money Wealth is the investing arm of Urban Money. It helps Indian households discover, start and track mutual fund investments in one place, from a first SIP of ₹100 to a portfolio measured in crores.

Where Urban Money helps people borrow wisely, Urban Money Wealth helps them grow what they keep. It carries the same promise of clear advice and adds the discipline, patience and polish that long-term investing asks for.

Core offerings
Mutual Fund Discovery 5000+ funds
Systematic Investment Plans from ₹100
Portfolio Tracking value · returns · XIRR
Curated Fund Lists most bought · top rated
Fund Categories equity · hybrid · global · commodity
Financial Calculators EMI · eligibility · more
Brand architecture

An endorsed sub-brand

Urban Money Wealth sits inside the Urban Money family. The masterbrand mark stays untouched; the gold Wealth pill names the vertical and carries its own premium tone. Customers should always feel they are dealing with Urban Money, in its investing mode.

( Inherited from Urban Money )

What stays the same

  • The U monogram and urban money wordmark
  • Typefaces: Archivo, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono
  • The Sage archetype: expert, clear, helpful
  • Trust signals: millions of Indians served, 150+ cities
( Owned by Wealth )

What makes it Wealth

  • The Wealth Gold gradient and dark Obsidian surfaces
  • The growth arrow as a graphic device
  • Gold 3D illustration and iconography
  • An investing voice: patient, precise, risk-aware
Brand archetype

The Sage × The Ruler

Urban Money Wealth is a calm, expert guide that brings order and discipline to how Indian families grow their money.
( Primary archetype · inherited )

If Urban Money Wealth were a person

Is not

Tone of voice

How Wealth speaks

( 1 )Numbers first, plainly

Lead with the figure and its period. "+24.2% over 3 years" says more than any adjective.

( 2 )Calm confidence

No countdowns, no fear of missing out. Wealth is built patiently, and the brand sounds like it.

( 3 )Honest about risk

Returns always carry their period and the market-risk disclaimer. Trust is the product.

Chapter 02

Logo

The Urban Money masterbrand, endorsed by a gold Wealth descriptor. One lockup, used the same way everywhere.

Primary lockup

Trust on top, growth beneath

The lockup stacks the Urban Money mark over the Wealth pill. The masterbrand above carries the trust Urban Money has built with borrowers; the gold pill below, with its rising arrow, signals the move from managing money to growing it.

The pill is part of the logo and never appears on its own as a sub-brand signature. Always use the supplied artwork files.

Anatomy

Three parts, one lockup

01U monogramThree rising bars resting on a U: the masterbrand symbol.
02Masterbrand markMonogram plus the urban money wordmark, unchanged from the parent identity.
03Wealth descriptor pillWealth Gold gradient, ivory lettering and the growth arrow. Width runs from the wordmark's left edge to its right.
Colour versions

Four approved versions

Use the full-colour versions wherever possible. The one-colour versions are for single-ink print, embossing, foiling and engraving.

Monogram

The U, for small spaces

Below the minimum lockup size, use the U monogram alone: app icons, favicons, social avatars and watermarks. Because the monogram is shared with Urban Money, Wealth uses it with gold: a gold monogram on Obsidian, or an Obsidian monogram on the Wealth Gold gradient.

½X½X
Clear space & minimum size

Give it room

X is the height of the Wealth pill. Keep at least half of X clear on every side; no text, edge or image may enter this zone.

Clear space½X all sides
Minimum width, digital120 px
Minimum width, print30 mm
Monogram minimum24 px · 6 mm
Preferred placementTop right or bottom left
Misuse

Never do this

Stretch, squash or distort the proportions.
Rotate or set the logo at an angle.
Recolour the pill or the mark outside the approved versions.
Rearrange the parts or move the pill beside the mark.
Place on busy imagery or a background with low contrast.
Add shadows, glows, outlines or bevels.

Typography

The Urban Money type family, unchanged. Wealth uses it with more air, fewer weights and very careful numbers.

Typefaces

Three faces, three jobs

Display · HeadlinesAaArchivo

ExtraBold 800 and Bold 700, width 100 to 115%. Headlines, big numbers on posters, chapter titles.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789 ₹%+
Body · InterfaceAaIBM Plex Sans

Light 300 to SemiBold 600. Running text, fund names, app interface and all figures.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789 ₹%+
Utility · LabelsAaIBM Plex Mono

Regular 400 to SemiBold 600, uppercase with wide tracking. Eyebrows, buttons, tags, data captions.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ 0123456789 ₹%+

All three are free on Google Fonts. Fallbacks: Helvetica Neue, Arial for Archivo and Plex Sans; Courier New for Plex Mono.

05
Chapter 05

Visual
Language

The growth arrow, gold-lit illustration, quiet surfaces and honest charts.

Graphic device

The growth arrow

Lifted from the Wealth pill, the arrow is the one graphic device Wealth owns. It always points up and to the right. Use it large and faint, cropped by the edge of the format, as on the business card.

Do

  • Keep the up-right direction
  • Use one arrow per layout
  • Let it bleed off the edge

Don't

  • Rotate it downward or sideways
  • Use it as a bullet or icon
  • Put text or figures on top of it at full strength
Illustration

Gold, lit in the dark

Hero illustrations are 3D renders in two materials: brushed gold and black metal. One warm key light from above, deep shadows, nothing cartoonish. Subjects are symbols of safekeeping and growth: vaults, coins, ledgers, rising bars.

  • Palette locked to gold, black and Obsidian
  • Single subject, centred, generous negative space
  • Rupee symbol on coins, never dollar or generic marks
Iconography

Two icon families

Data visualisation

Charts that tell the truth

Fund cards use a single Growth Green line with a soft green fill fading to Graphite. No gridlines, no axes inside cards; the return figure underneath carries the meaning.

  • Always print the period next to the figure: (3Y), (1Y), p.a.
  • Green for gains, red for losses, never gold
  • Same time period across cards that sit side by side
  • Detailed views may add axes in #8E9194 at 1px
Interface elements

Surfaces & components

Obsidian is the ground, Graphite cards sit on it with a 1px border and 14px radius. Buttons speak in Plex Mono capitals. Gold is reserved for the single most important action.
